name: Imperial Circle Spam
short_description:
[b][h1]Imperial Circle Spam[/h1][/b]

"Fixing" some Imperial Circles interactions. Built against [b]1.3.11[/b], no dependencies.

[b]Disclaimer[/b]: Claude Code was used to create this. Do what you will with this info,  but if you want to report a bug or suggest a change, feel free.

[b][h2]Petition the Imperial Diet[/h2][/b]
A Circle Leader "petitions" you to vote on something, but doesn't say what. You accept, and only then find out you're voting on something you didn't want.

The popup now names the law, the policy they want, the policy you've currently got, and the votes each is projected to draw. Hover the policy name to see what it actually does.

I also wanted to give at least some reason to accept the petition.
[list]
[*][b]Accept[/b] and you gain 0.5 to 2.5 Imperial Authority, scaled to the petitioner. That whole law is then shut to every Circle Leader for 5 years.
[*][b]Refuse[/b] and they lose prestige and opinion of you, and that one policy cannot be petitioned again for 5 years.
[/list]

Either way you should get some peace.

[i]New in 0.41[/i]: the vote projection was broken and always came back unanimous, it's now real numbers. Petitions also no longer notify countries with nothing to do with them.

[b][h2]Request Circle Privilege[/h2][/b]
Vanilla doesn't seem to stop AI from re-asking this. Now it should (hopefully?).

[list]
[*]10 years before that leader can ask again, whether you granted it or not.
[*]A circle that already holds the privilege can't ask for another.
[*]If you hate them, they don't get to ask at all.
[/list]

[b][h2]Request County Privileges[/h2][/b]
[i]New in 0.41[/i]. AI princes now have to merit this before asking: treasury against the price, government power, stability and reform fit. Refuse and that prince stays quiet for 5 years. Nothing changes for a human.

[b][h2]Request Financial Grant from Circle Diet[/h2][/b]
A Circle member asks its Circle Leader for 1/5th of [b]the leader's[/b] yearly income, which IMO is insane, so now it's a fifth of [b]their own[/b] income instead, capped at a month of the leader's, and you can see the amount too. Anyone sitting on six months of income doesn't ask.

They should also not ask again for like 5 years, whether you pay up or not.

[i]New in 0.41[/i]: the popup names the sum actually sent, not the sum they asked for.

[b][h2]Automatic Approval[/h2][/b]
[i]New in 0.41[/i]. Three of these requests cost you nothing to say yes to, so you can stop being asked. Hit [b]Automatic Approval is Off[/b] and your chancery handles [i]Request Military Infrastructure Expansion[/i], [i]Elevate Country in Circle[/i] and [i]Request County Privileges[/i] from then on.

[list]
[*]No popup. You get a line in the message feed instead, which you can mute or turn back into a popup from the message settings.
[*]Everyone still gets what vanilla gives them: the asker gets the grant, you still get the circle satisfaction, and you still get paid for county privileges.
[*]At most one grant of each kind every 2 years, so it can't be farmed.
[*]Hit [b]Automatic Approval is On[/b] and it all comes back to you.
[/list]

The button is on the circle card and on the HRE panel's Overview tab, and both do the same thing, so it doesn't matter whether you're the Emperor, a Circle Leader or both.

[b][h3]Compatibility[/h3][/b]
Replaces three country interactions: [i]petition_imperial_diet[/i], [i]request_circle_privilege[/i] and [i]appeal_to_circle_diet[/i]. Adds AI gates to three more without replacing them: [i]request_county_privileges[/i], [i]request_circle_infrastructure_expansion[/i] and [i]request_new_circle_titles[/i]. Any mod touching those six will conflict.

The Automatic Approval button on the HRE panel needs one GUI type, [i]organization_panel_overview_area[/i], so any mod that redraws the organization panel's Overview tab will conflict too. No GUI file is replaced, and nothing else vanilla ships is overwritten.

Should be mid-save safe, but don't yell at me if it breaks your run or I'll cry.
